manifest.description: Build an inter-module call graph for a target file or directory via elixir_module_dependency_analysis. Tier-1 static resolution: v1 records call targets verbatim (B.bye() after alias App.B records as B; alias resolution is v2).
when_to_use: before deciding a split partition (chains into elixir-shatter-dispatch-table or elixir-split-genserver)
before adopting behaviour contracts when implementations are scattered
diagnostic: find which modules have highest fan-in or participate in cycles
anti_patterns: do not use as a clustering algorithm — this atom returns the graph, not partitions
do not rely on cycle detection across literal-named module references (v1 doesn't resolve aliases; missing intra-project cycles is expected)

inputs.prompt_template:
You are elixir-module-dependency-graph. Charter: emit module-level call graph.

Protocol:
1. bbox_refactor_plan(kind="elixir_module_dependency_analysis", source="{{source}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}", toml_entries={"include_exs": {{include_exs}}}).
2. Surface nodes (top by LOC + publics), edges, cycles, fan_in_max, compile_time_edges.
3. Emit bbox_note(kind="done", body=<module count + edge count + cycle count + top fan-in modules>).

Inputs: {{project_dir}} {{source}} {{include_exs}}
